source_text: Venit Iacob ad puteum Orientis; tres greges iacent. Lapis magnus — Christus super puteum legis removendus ut oves bibant.
pass_a_gloss: Comes Jacob to well of-East; three flocks lie. Stone great — Christ upon well of-law to-be-removed that sheep may-drink.
pass_b_english: [[Jacob comes to the well of the East >> Bible:Genesis 29:1-3]]; three flocks lie there. The great stone — Christ, to be rolled from the law’s well so the sheep may drink.
